criticism: The function mintToken does not check if the transfer of tokens to the owner and the sender is successful. This could lead to loss of funds if the transfer fails.
The function buy does not check if the transfer of tokens to the sender is successful.
The function sell does not check if the transfer of tokens from the sender to the owner is successful.
The function distr does not check if the transfer of tokens to the recipient is successful.
The function distribute does not check if the transfer of tokens to the recipients is successful.
The function airdrop does not check if the transfer of tokens to the recipients is successful.
The function withdraw does not check if the transfer of ether to the owner is successful.
The function withdrawForeignTokens does not check if the transfer of foreign tokens to the owner is successful.
